contexts.text: Many (there) can speak well, from habit...
The Rational has been given to men... to the end that everyone may wish well and do well to another.
Those who will evilly, and yet... speak well.
Thus does he pass from thinking well into willing well.
When it shall be well with thee () = when there is correspondence... For it is not well with the exterior Natural until it corresponds.
In its essence, charity is to will well to the neighbour...
If a man receives (the Divine influx) it is well with him; but if not, it is evil with him.

When the external man has been regenerated, the internal man makes all good consist in thinking well about the neighbour, and in willing well to him; and the external man makes it consist in speaking well about him, and in acting well towards him.

When a man thinks well about the Lord, and about the things which belong to Him; and when he thinks well about the neighbour, and about the things which belong to him, and wills well to these, he then thinks and wills from the internal...
Everyone (has) his place in Heaven, if he lives well.
That they are saved who acknowledge God, and live well. Explained.
The good of life, that is, to live well, is to shun evils because they are contrary to religion.
The Angels then said, Well... TCR 188:2.
They then heard voices from Heaven, saying. Well, well, well.
(Thus do wives) know whether it is well (with their husbands).
On hearing this, we said. Well. TCR 35:11.
Charity is to live well; and faith is to believe rightly.
That he who lives well, and believes rightly, is saved... and that he who believes rightly, and does not live well is [not] saved, (is seen by everyone from perception). (Continued. See Life.)
